title: Explain incomplete held-claim reads in named launcher registration refusals
outcome: A launcher blocked by an incomplete held-claim list receives a reason and next action that apply even when it owns no claim on the retained name.
acceptance: A held-list truncation case with no matching claim identifies incomplete ownership evidence and advises obtaining a complete held read. The handler still refuses before stages start.
A complete unrelated held list still allows ordinary unbound registration, and an applicable retained name with a missing selection still gets the existing confirmation remedy.
